capabilities: ask AI about selected text, notes and images in a sidebar
attach files to conversations via drag-and-drop or [[ links
configure multiple model connections and saved conversation roles
keep conversation history locally with context compaction for long chats
enable web search for online information
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.7+ on desktop; mobile and PDF input are not supported. The plugin is free but model and search usage are billed through the user's own provider. States it has no telemetry or developer-operated backend and cannot edit notes or search arbitrary vault files. Full user guide, provider setup and changelog are linked externally.
problem: Asking AI about a passage in a note means copying it into an external chat app and manually re-establishing what context the model should see.
summary: AI question-answering sidebar that explains selected text, files and images, with local conversation history and explicit context control.
